en: Black-and-white street view showing a broad boulevard with tram tracks and overhead wires, lined with neoclassical buildings and a long fence with columns on the right. In the background a rocky hill with a small structure on top rises above trees. Vintage automobiles and pedestrians are visible. Printed captions in Greek and English appear along the bottom border, and a website watermark is faintly visible across the image.
